item_winds_daggers.name: Wind's Daggers
item_winds_daggers.description: This magic dagger is composed of five blades, that can be combined to form a single dagger. While they're all combined, they act as a regular dagger and cannot use any of it's special properties.
item_winds_daggers.magicEffect: This dagger has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. You can choose to activate these daggers at will, making them float around you as you wish. While they float around you, they can be used to attack as if you had a dagger on each hand, but can only be used as such when you are holding no other weapons or shields. While the daggers are floating and as a bonus action, you can choose to spend some of it's charges to send daggers flying at a creature. This throw must follow the original weapon's throwing property's range. For each charge spent a dagger will be thrown, but you must roll to hit each throw. Once you throw the last of these dagggers that is on your person, one of them flies back into your hand.

item_bamboozles_staff.name: Bamboozle's Staff
item_bamboozles_staff.magicEffect: Once per long rest, you can cast Mirror Image with this staff.

item_runeblade.name: Runeblade
item_runeblade.magicEffect:
This blade has been magically enhanced to contain magic within it. Three deactivated runes adorn the blade. Once activated, each rune glows a vibrant baby blue.

Only one rune can be activated per turn. To activate a rune the creature attuned to it must deal magic damage to a creature other than itself or use any type of rune magic.

You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can expend activated runes as a bonus action.

1 rune cost - Cast Green-Flame Blade as a bonus action

2 rune cost - As a bonus action strike the ground beneath your blade. All creatures within 1,5 meters of you must make a Constitution saving throw of a DC 14 or become stunned until the start of their next turn

3 rune cost - Activating all 3 runes makes the blade you're holding grow. The light within the runes is now a slight aura aura the whole blade. The weapon gains the light, finesse and throwable (10/18 meters) properties, if it didn't already. Its damage increases from 2d6 to 2d8. This effect lasts for 1 minute, until dispelled or until your concentration is broken.
